title: Nury M Probable NDE 6455
content: In 1995 August 6 my life changed. In all of Colombia, the electricity was off and we had a heavy rain, with fog plus the appearance of two spaceships in the sky. I was a witness with my friend. My mind became one with them, and my entire being was emptied and filled with light and power. They left and in the newspaper EL TIEMPO (THE TIME) the picture of the two spaceships visiting the world: entering from Argentina crossing Colombia, Miami and New York (in all countries there was same effect). After that I divorced my first spouse and started to wonder about the visits I had of saints and beings of light during my sleep doing things in my body taking out dust. I was filled with light in my ears and heart happiness. I came back told to my mother I saw my grandparents' death and I slept again and continued to be there with them. During the fevers, for three days my mind was like in parallel worlds: I could be here and talk to others and at the same time my mind was like seeing my own mind in different times or lives, all passed so fast. Passing tunnels of darkness and tunnels of light and finally at the end of the tunnel of light to arrive to a place full of light where I recognized was my great grandparents and grandparents and others persons darling to me that had passed away. They were holding me with so much love and welcomed me to that place. I was full of peace and happiness. I came back to tell my mother I saw my grandparents' deaths. I slept again and continued to be there with them. I came back to tell my mother I saw my grandparents' deaths. I slept again and continued to be there with them. My mother became very fearful and called a doctor to come to my home. When he came, I was dying, feeling such peace and happiness. He did not feel a pulse in me but my mind was with the heaven. He rushed me to the hospital, where they admitted me for 5 days administering antibiotics and serum. Afterwards, I only know that I was recovered but I was not 'Nury' anymore. I could even listen to Nury from afar trying to come into my body but in me was another light, another consciousness, a very powerful being that cut off all of my previous life. It took me out of Colombia and took me to India and then Thailand. After the death experience, I was not attached to anything in Colombia. I divorced, sold my house, gave my properties to relatives and poor people and made two bags with little things for me and my daughter of 8 years. Then in alpha dreams, God brought my mind to Him in a place like a sun, but inside was empty and full of bliss. He told me many things that I listened to, but I did not have a clear understanding but it moved me out my life and my work to leave Colombia and settle in India. God did a lot of work in me especially before they took Nury out of me. In May 25 1996 a man came to me, I never saw him before during my alpha dream. He called me and told me, 'wake up, start the cleaning.' I told him, 'it was too early, only 3 am let me sleep more'. He pulled me up by my hair and made me sit to pray, in alpha he was a person familiar to me but when I woke up I wondered who he was, I never saw him. The same morning in the hospital where I worked, somebody saw him walking at my side. They asked me 'who is the man at your side?' I told them I came alone, but I saw him too, in my alpha but they saw him in reality. That happened in India where many people saw him, but in India, I could not recognize him. Only when I came to Thailand to I recognize him as the King of Thailand. I left Colombia and came to meet Parthasarathi Rajagopalachari in Chennai India the president of Sri Rama Chandra mission they have a research center in raja yoga , I was preceptor for 3 years and gave initiations to many Indians in that yoga experience. I felt Jesus was always with me and wanted me to find him in the Vedas, yoga and Buddha since he walked that land and mixed with all of them. Later I wished to be a nun, so I left Chennai and traveled all of India from temple to temple now with the Ramakrishna's mission where Swamiji Ranganathananda, the president, welcomed me to travel in his temples in each city all over India. I was only in temples with monks, and 3 days in each place from Kanyakumari Calcula to Himalaya, Nepal to Cochin, Ladakh. My life was vegetarian and celibacy at that time; living fully in the spiritual world with a lot of experiences but with the help of the Christian saints giving me light. The space ships were there too, filling every temple where I was sleeping like we were working together in the mission to bring the Lord Jesus to India's consciousness. After 5 years in India, I met a doctor in philosophy who was a Buddhist monk from Thailand. We fell in love, married and had two kids. He brought me to Thailand. Only in Thailand did I recognize the man travelling with me from Colombia, all through India and now here in Thailand: it was the King. I tried to reach him to ask him why he called me, why did he bring me here by many ways. When I was working in Mahachulalongkorn University in Wat Mahathat [Editor's Note: It is the common short name of several important Buddhist temples in Thailand.] Suddenly the king came to the hospital Siri raj. At the university where I worked so I started to go there to pray for him and to read the Catholic bible I had gotten. I met many of his advisers, all were so kind to me and I was trying to figure out what soul God had put into my body??? I discovered I worked in Wat Mahathat, where the mother of the king practiced meditation. I am living in Nonthabuti the home town of the mother of the king, I've got three kids like the mother of the king, and I work in Siri raj the place she founded. Yet still I am not sure if that soul like Buddha inside me is her? I also discovered that the king had a Catholic nun care for him when he was a 2-year-old boy. I wondered if perhaps the soul of her needed me at the feet of the king reading the bible to him in Siri raj when he was 2 years old: was it God's will to keep us close? The work in Thailand is very hard especially the terrible experience of the dark side of the world and underworld that God opened my eyes to see and hear. I could experience in India Shiva, Kali (like the city where I studied), Krishna and in Thailand Buddha his heaven and many Chinese Bodhisattva and yet not one of them could help me to close my eye to the underworld: only my Lord Jesus could do it. During my stay in the hospital, praying for the King, God said to me, 'don't go away, the king will come down now and you will see him' and yet anything could happen and I left hospital and the king came down and we could not meet each other. Exactly 16 years after he came to me in Cali, Colombia on May 25 2012 I met his majesty. Two days before my blood had come down to 8.4 hemoglobin: exactly like the age of the king 84 years. I did not know I would see him that day in May. Jesus came in a white dress to heal me and told me 'now you will meet the king, I will be with you'. Like He said, I met the king after 16 years and all the years of him visiting me in my dreams and calling me with his spirit to pray for his country. The experience was incredible and painful, too, since my body became one with his. With his sickness, the Lord will take it from both of us as His cross. I listened to Nury far from here; He came to return me to Nury, since I now need this soul in me to reach the king for God's grace. In Thailand in the earth, the Chinese masters are walking and one of them wished to enter my body: it was full of light and love but would take me out of Thailand to China. I prayed to God to not let that soul in my body but to finish my work in Thailand. I could feel that the soul was a great, nice, lovely and one with God. I loved the mood to be allowing it in but I prayed to God: 'protect me, Lord'. God let me know even the Buddha in heaven I listen them singing song happy I am here and yet I concentrate myself only in Jesus since he is the real only savior as mentioned even by Buddha. My hemoglobin would not come up with vitamins or food so I decided to do a fasting while reading the book of Doctor John W. Armstrong: 'The Water of Life!' At the same moment, I came to my balcony and I saw a rare light opening in the heaven in my real awakened state the heaven open to see clearly the light was Jesus on the cross full of light. My mind became so still and I felt I was completely healed. Then I ran to take photos of the image in the sky, when I returned the clouds covered the cross with Jesus but the heaven opened again to present four huge spaceships turning, full of light and so fast in the sky. I did a fasting of 20 days, not food only water and urine as I did on other occasions and I was healed when God said to me. 'Take out of your house any image of Buddha or gods in your house. Even Buddha never wished people to worship images'. I took them out and I was healed! I believe the heaven opened for me, several times, in Thailand to see the space ships; or a cloud following me everywhere I went to shadow me, as if the sun or a fresh breeze specially filling the places where I worked with God. In my craving for God, I had asked Him, 'I am tired of seeing this cloud following me please show me your face.' Out of the clouds came seven lights like spaceships emitting light all around. I believe they were the seven spirits of God mentioned in revelations. The King accompanied me every day in my mind: I could feel his mind and experience my unity with Him and how God loves him. In one of his communications with me in alpha dream, the king told me, 'Nury we were witness of God from Egypt to the Promised Land. We saw all the power God showed Moses.' Then after that, a high priest in Jerusalem told me: 'I WAS A WITNESS OF SINAI, I saw and listened to God'. So the priest told me what the king told me too in alpha dream, or in meditation.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: She describes being moved to leave Colombia and settle in India/Thailand, praying for the King, and “to bring the Lord Jesus to India's consciousness.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: “During the fevers, for three days…”; doctor “did not feel a pulse in me” and she was hospitalized 5 days with antibiotics/serum.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Also reports “parallel worlds,” repeated returns to tell her mother, and later extensive alpha-dream communications/visions involving Jesus, saints/beings of light, and “spaceships.”
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Reports fever/parallel worlds, then “tunnels of darkness and tunnels of light,” then arrival to a light-filled place with deceased loved ones; she describes repeated cycles of returning (waking/telling mother) and “slept again and continued to be there with them.”
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Repeated returning to her mother and then “slept again and continued to be there with them.”
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: “for three days my mind was like in parallel worlds: I could be here and talk to others and at the same time my mind was like seeing my own mind in different times or lives”

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reports UFO/spaceship phenomena connected with the experience; repeated “alpha dream” communications; perceived replacement/overlay of identity (“I was not 'Nury' anymore… another consciousness”); identification of a recurring figure later recognized as the King of Thailand; later visions of Jesus on the cross in the sky and multiple “spaceships”; underworld perceptions that “only… Jesus could” close.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Passing tunnels of darkness and tunnels of light and finally at the end of the tunnel of light to arrive to a place full of light where I recognized was my great grandparents and grandparents…”; “They were holding me with so much love and welcomed me to that place. I was full of peace and happiness.”; “When he came, I was dying… He did not feel a pulse in me but my mind was with the heaven.”; “Afterwards… I was not 'Nury' anymore… another light, another consciousness.”
